blocks.html: Notwithstanding the provisions of Sections 507.3 and 507.4, the area of a Group F-2 building of Type IIA, IIIA or IV construction shall not be limited where the building is protected throughout with an approved automatic sprinkler system in accordance with Section 903.3.1.1.
